Name: Buildable tent
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Just continuing my adventure of trying out all the different modding tools. This adds a tent to the TMXL buildables menu ( F2 by default). You can sleep in it. Costs 500g and 2 cloth to make.

Requires TMXLoader, which in turn requires PyTK, to run

[b]Note:[/b] TMXL has a known issue when trying to remove buildables on certain maps during the play session. After saving, restarting the game will properly remove the buildable

Comes with two tents: the vanilla yellow, and a more desaturated one from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4080]ATDSV[/url] (the one in the previews)

Thanks a lot to mouse and minervamaga from the stardew valley modding discord for helping me get the hang of TMXL!

Downloads.Description: Uses own .png rather than vanilla to avoid problems with the tilesheet's name on different maps
